schema.sprite.title: Sprites
schema.sprite.name: Sprite
schema.sprite.doc: spriteTypes definitions in interface/*.gfx: the name windows use, its texture and its frames.
schema.sprite.field.name: Name
schema.sprite.field.name.help: The game looks up many elements by this name: do not change it in a game window.
schema.sprite.field.texturefile.help: Path of the image file (.dds or .tga; the game also tries the other extension).
schema.sprite.field.no_of_frames.help: How many frames the texture has, as a horizontal strip.
schema.sprite.field.border_size.help: Inner margin in pixels (for a cornered sprite, the corners that are not stretched).
